[SWS_UCM_00018] Providing Progress Information
⌈
UCM
shall provide a method
GetSwProcessProgress
to query the progress of executing the
ProcessSwPack-
age
method call for provided TransferId. Parameter
progress
shall be set to a value
representing the progress between 0% and 100% (0x00 ... 0x64).
⌋
(RS_UCM_00023)
